scope: A conservative obligation audit, not a minimal dynamic closure. Generic callback-signature expansion deliberately overincludes unrelated bodies. Every static unresolved site is assigned a named boundary below; no unresolved site counts as executed or implemented.

debug: Rust assertions and explicit error paths
pseudochecker: partial-syntax declaration helper used by native emit
transformers: declarations in S08; other emitted output Phase 3

callback_boundaries.context_runtime: context.Context cancellation/Done/Err. Preserve cooperative cancellation semantics; runtime scheduling is outside the semantic port. Native implementations are standard-library context, with incremental and IPC callers overincluded by CHA.
callback_boundaries.reflection_runtime: reflect.Type inspection in native option/package-JSON decoding. Existing S07 typed declarations and option/package-JSON probes are the Rust boundary; Go reflect itself is not a new checker algorithm.
callback_boundaries.iterator_continuation: Go range-over-function yield or maps.Keys/Values/sync.Map.Range continuation. Port the caller's loop/body and collection order, not a user-supplied unknown algorithm. Concrete callbacks and surrounding generic bodies remain in the conservative function inventory; SSA may retain unspecialized templates. Check caller traversal at its algorithm checkpoint.
callback_boundaries.checker_pool_factory: Program.initCheckerPool checks ProgramOptions.CreateCheckerPool; native baseline constructs ProgramOptions without this override and takes newCheckerPoolWithTracing. Custom pool injection is not a frozen request. Checker operation ownership remains a P2 implementation obligation.
callback_boundaries.encoder_generic_template: Uninstantiated GetOrComputeSourceFileData[T] closure included by signature expansion. Concrete uses at the pin are internal/api/encoder/encoder.go:409,419, outside these roots; preserve existing S06 encoder lazy-data behavior, not a new S08 callback.
callback_boundaries.extended_config_cache: Optional tsoptions.ExtendedConfigCache.GetExtendedConfig callback; native compiler fixture builds options directly, and config resolver inputs are S07 pre-checker work. Do not return empty cache entries in a future real implementation; existing config-resolver fixture authority applies.
callback_boundaries.source_map_host: sourcemap.ECMAHost.GetECMALineInfo is a source-map consumption callback. Current primary schedule collects declaration diagnostics but no source-map output or mapped external files. Guarded boundary, not a fabricated nil host implementation.
callback_boundaries.mapper_process_runtime: contentmapper.SpawnerFunc/IPC net.Listener/net.Addr/Close are process and transport boundaries. Frozen ordinary acceptance inputs exclude external mapper execution. Informational execution remains separately recorded; no successful no-op host adapter is authorized.
callback_boundaries.locale_matcher: golang.org/x/text/language.Matcher.Match selects localized diagnostic tables. Capture uses the native default locale; preserve selected message keys and argument text. External language matcher bodies are runtime boundaries.
